title: Stratton Bay License Administration Fee and Managed Security Baseline by Microsoft 365 Plan
content:
For each Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) plan, this schedule gives Stratton Bay's own license administration fee per license, whether the plan's fee is subject to waiver for ClearPath clients, and whether Stratton Bay deploys its managed security baseline on the plan.

| Plan | License administration fee (USD per license per month) | Fee waived while the client's ClearPath agreement covers Microsoft 365 administration | Stratton Bay conditional access and device compliance baseline deployed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft 365 Business Basic | 1.50 | yes | no |
| Microsoft 365 F3 | 1.50 | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 Business Standard | 1.50 | yes | no |
| Microsoft 365 Business Premium | 1.50 | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E3 (no Teams) | 2.25 | yes | yes |
| Microsoft 365 E5 (no Teams) | 2.25 | yes | yes |

## Column meanings

- **License administration fee**: Stratton Bay's license administration fee per license per month, in USD.
- **Waiver switch**: whether the administration fee is waived while the client's ClearPath agreement covers Microsoft 365 administration.
- **Security baseline**: whether Stratton Bay deploys its conditional access and device compliance baseline for the plan. The baseline needs Entra ID P1 and Intune.

## Notes on the schedule

- The fee is a Stratton Bay charge and is separate from the Microsoft license price.
- The fee per license is 1.50 USD on the four Business and frontline plans and 2.25 USD on the two E plans.
- The security baseline is deployed on Microsoft 365 F3, Microsoft 365 Business Premium and both E plans. It is not deployed on Microsoft 365 Business Basic or Microsoft 365 Business Standard.
